name: Cheval Blanc St-Barth Isle de France
address: Baie des Flamands, 97133 Saint-Barthélemy, French West Indies
tagline: Sixty rooms, suites and one villa on Flamands Beach, in gardens by Madison Cox.
description:
Cheval Blanc St-Barth is a hotel of 60 rooms, suites and bungalows, plus the five-bedroom Villa de France, on Flamands Beach in Saint-Barthélemy. It is the only Palace in the Caribbean, and has been an institution on the island for 35 years.

The hotel stands on the beach at the Baie des Flamands, a few minutes by car from the airport and the harbour at Gustavia, with gardens designed by Madison Cox. Jacques Grange has redesigned the interiors, with handcrafted furniture in natural materials, and Jean-Michel Othoniel's mobile sculpture of coloured glass pearls, The Constellation of Pegasus, hangs in the hotel. Blush pink is the signature colour of the house.

The rooms range from the Tropical Room and the Ocean Room to garden and hillside bungalows with pools. The Garden Junior Suite measures 70 square metres including its terrace and has a private or shared pool. The 2-Bedroom Beach House covers 160 square metres, with a terrace that opens onto the sand through a few steps and a private hot tub. The Villa de France stands in front of the ocean on two floors and 650 square metres, with five bedrooms, a private spa and fitness room, a dining room for ten and two private infinity-edge pools, and a dedicated majordome.

Langosteria serves Italian cooking daily for lunch and dinner. La Cabane sits beside Flamands Beach and is open from noon to 8 pm, the Tiki Bar opens from 10 am to 6 pm, and Le Kiosque is the bakery. In-room dining runs around the clock.

The Cheval Blanc Spa uses Guerlain treatments and opens daily from 10 am to 8 pm. The beach and pools are open from 8 am to sunset, the fitness studio is open at all hours and yoga takes place in the Tropical Pavilion. The hotel arranges Mini-Moke drives, hikes and sailing at sunset.

The hotel suits those who want a beach hotel with a house feel, in bungalows set among the gardens or on the sand itself.
